verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own CLI is documented for use 'through an automated system' to run API tests and 'manage automated API monitoring', with JUnit reports for collection runs. That gives a first-party, non-interactive path for automated runs. However, nothing shows Hoppscotch itself scheduling or running automations autonomously in the background; triggering appears to depend on an external CI system or scheduler. Missing for 10: built-in scheduled monitors or background job execution, documented scheduling and triggers, agent-driven autonomous workflows, hands-on corroboration.
